caption.text:
Mobil yang terparkir di area SPBU tiba-tiba meluncur sendiri saat sang sopir pergi ke toilet. Diduga, kendaraan diparkir di lokasi yang sedikit menurun sehingga bergerak tanpa pengemudi.

Beruntung, petugas SPBU yang melihat kejadian itu langsung berlari mengejar dan berhasil menghentikan mobil sebelum masuk ke jalan raya.

Salut untuk kesigapan petugas SPBU yang berhasil mencegah hal yang tidak diinginkan! 

#Okezone #PetugasSPBU #Viral
caption.text_translation:
The car parked in the gas station area suddenly slid by itself when the driver went to the toilet. It is suspected that the vehicle was parked in a location that was slightly lowered to the point of moving without a driver.

Fortunately, the SPBU officer who saw the incident immediately ran after and managed to stop the car before entering the highway.

Salute to the promptness of SPBU officers who successfully prevent the unwanted things!

 #Okezone #PetugasSPBU #Viral
